command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_01','AGG_SW_02','AGG_SW_03','AGG_SW_04','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','ChinaUnicom_SW','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','PE1','PE2','PE3','SH_AR','SH_Core','SW-DMZ-ACC-01','SZ_AR','SZ_Core'); `$cmds=@('display current-configuration','show running-config'); foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { foreach (`$c in `$cmds) { `$e=[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$e; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$e; try { `$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1; `$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2 } catch { continue }; if ((`$a.output -notlike 'Error: Command*') -and (`$b.output -notlike 'Error: Command*')) { `$d=Compare-Object (`$a.output -split '\r?\n') (`$b.output -split '\r?\n'); if (`$d) { Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n+' CMD='+`$c+' DIFF='+`$d.Count); `$d | Select-Object -First 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject) } } } } }"
